FROM spark/glm-tp4-build:rdma02 AS probe_build
COPY glm-probe03-04.patch /tmp/glm-probe03-04.patch
RUN cd /tensorfold && git apply /tmp/glm-probe03-04.patch && /opt/zig/zig build -Dnvcc=/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc -Dsm=121 -Doptimize=fast --prefix /opt/tensorfold -j4 glm-transport-probe
FROM spark/glm-tp4:zig-a6c7e08-rdma-02
COPY --from=probe_build /opt/tensorfold/bin/tf-glm-transport-probe /opt/tensorfold/bin/tf-glm-transport-probe
